capabilities: Render ```isokit YAML code blocks in notes as isometric SVG diagrams
Pan, zoom, reset, and collapse the legend via overlay controls, including on mobile
Author diagrams as semantic YAML without coordinates
Enforce grid, axis-locked routing, collision, and overflow invariants, failing generation on violations
Render errors in-note with block-relative line numbers for agent self-correction
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README targets the underlying CLI/library (requires Node >= 23.6 to build), with the Obsidian plugin packaged in an obsidian/ subfolder; the renderer is offline (fonts embedded, no network or filesystem access) and works on mobile. Auto-placement and a published agent spec are listed as future roadmap phases.
motivation: The author argues auto-layout tools optimize topology legibility and all look alike, whereas isometric presentation quality lives in placement judgment best supplied by an AI agent directed by human critique, with the renderer enforcing everything checkable.
problem: Obsidian offers no way to author and render presentation-grade isometric architecture diagrams from declarative YAML inside notes, with the renderer catching layout errors instead of shipping broken output.

relations.evidence: the candidate end state (mermaid.live-style static web app with URL-encoded diagrams

summary: Renders isokit YAML code blocks as self-contained isometric architecture-diagram SVGs with in-note pan, zoom, and legend controls.
